messages:
maria_support: FYI customer AcmePay opened a Sev2 about sudden p95/p99 latency regressions after we flipped the int8 quant profile on their model (model: gpt-open-2.3-int8, route: prod-us-east).
eli_runtime: saw the alert, can you drop the basic numbers?
maria_support: p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~420ms, p99 from ~320ms -> ~1.2s starting ~2026-03-12T14:02Z. Error rates didn't change. Only change was enabling default quant_profile=int8 via rollout. Ticket: #INC-8421.
tanya_ml: int8 usually reduces token time — weird. Do we have traces/fortress traces for slow requests?
maria_support: attached short trace snippets in ticket, but quick reproduction curl below worked from our side: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-2.3-int8","input":"long context ... (2000 tokens)"}'
```
eli_runtime: thanks — can you also include the request params? sequence length, streaming on/off, batching?
maria_support: streaming=off, max_tokens=256, prompt ~1800 tokens, batch size was default (1). No function calls.
eli_runtime: that helps. Top hypothesis: int8 kernels for attention + KV cache aren't optimized for very long context in our current kernel set. For long prefixes we hit a dequantize path that copies + converts, then re-quantizes on KV updates -> extra memcpy and compute. That shows as p95/p99 tail.
luis_sre: also saw on infra side: when quantized kernels fallback (calibration mismatch or unsupported op) we route to an emulation path that runs on CPU or slower fp16 fallback path. If the runtime is switching between int8 and fp16 per-request, that causes jitter and long tails.
tanya_ml: any logs that indicate "calibration_mismatch" or "kernel_fallback"?
maria_support: trace shows a handful of logs: `[inference] quant_calib: zero_point_out_of_range` and `kernel: fallback_to_fp16_for_attention` around the slow requests.
eli_runtime: OK that matches. Quick mitigations we can do before a full patch: 1) Rollback quant_profile for AcmePay to fp16 (safe). 2) Add a per-route soft cap on sequence length for int8 traffic (reject or route to fp16 if > 1024). 3) Increase calibration sample size and re-run calibration offline, publish new int8 profile.
maria_support: customer asked for an immediate workaround to reduce p99 — they want minimal disruption. Which of those is fastest?
eli_runtime: rollback to fp16 for their route is fastest (config change, immediate). We can also enable a short-lived routing policy to send >1024 tokens to fp16. Will open a rollback PR to console.
luis_sre: I'll add an autoscaling noise buffer to reduce cold-path penalties while kernel fallback happens. Not a fix but reduces tail.
tanya_ml: for root cause: calibration likely used too few representative batches; for attention layers the quantization range drifts with prefix length and kv cache values. Need to add dynamic range collection during KV cache warmup and ensure zero_point/scale are stable.
eli_runtime: plan: (A) rollback AcmePay to fp16 today, (B) schedule re-calibration run (tanya + infra) with longer-context corpora, (C) create a canary with the new int8 profile on 1% traffic and run perf harness, (D) instrument per-kernel fallback counters and tracing.
maria_support: customer notified: we'll rollback and follow up with perf numbers + timeline. They want ETA for rollback — can we do within 30m?
eli_runtime: yes. I'll push route config change now. ping @deploy-bot to note the rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: route-change prod-us-east for customer:AcmePay (rollback quant_profile -> fp16). JobID=deploy-59321.
luis_sre: applied temporary routing policy to divert >1024 token requests to fp16 variant.
eli_runtime: rollback applied. please validate from your side, @maria_support.
maria_support: verifying... i ran same curl, now p95 ~130ms p99 ~280ms. customer confirms latency dropped. :raised_hands:
tanya_ml: next steps: I'll run an expanded calibration job with these parameters: `--calib-samples 5000 --max-context 4096 --include-kv-warmup true` and collect per-layer scales. Then produce new int8 profile and run the perf harness (perfbench) across seq lengths.
eli_runtime: also adding a quick protective config in runtime: if kernel_fallback_counter for a route > 5/min, auto-disable int8 for that route and emit an incident. I'll open a PR for the autoprotection rule.
maria_support: awesome, I'll update ticket #INC-8421 with rollback timestamp, new repro logs, and our mitigation plan. Customer asked for a follow-up meeting tomorrow.
luis_sre: assigning follow-up to tanya_ml + eli_runtime. tagging here so SRE can monitor after new int8 profile testing.
tanya_ml: noted.
eli_runtime: moving to postmortem/teardown once new calib and canary complete.
maria_support: thanks everyone.
_notes: Short thread: support escalates p95/p99 spike after int8 roll, runtime + ML confirm fallback/calibration issue, rollback to fp16, mitigations planned.
